name: financial-statements
title: Financial statements
for_each: select e.id,e.code||' '||c.name as label from engagements e join clients c on c.id=e.client_id order by e.code

sections.title: Entity and period
sections.sql: select c.name as entity,c.entity_type,c.jurisdiction,e.period_start,e.period_end,e.status,e.signed_by,e.signed_on from engagements e join clients c on c.id=e.client_id where e.id=$1
sections.note: Draft until the status reads signed or issued. Special purpose statements prepared from the trial balance.

sections.title: Statement of financial performance
sections.sql: select section,label as line,currency,current_cents,prior_cents from statement_lines where engagement_id=$1 and statement='performance' order by sort

sections.title: Statement of financial position
sections.sql: select section,label as line,currency,current_cents,prior_cents from statement_lines where engagement_id=$1 and statement='position' order by sort

sections.title: Equity
sections.note: Closing equity is opening capital and retained earnings plus this year's profit. It equals net assets when the trial balance balances and every account is mapped.

name: client-queries
title: Information we still need
for_each: select distinct e.id,e.code||' '||c.name as label from engagements e join clients c on c.id=e.client_id join queries q on q.engagement_id=e.id where q.status='open' order by label

sections.title: To finish your accounts
sections.sql: select code as reference,question,due_on as needed_by from queries where engagement_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on,code
sections.note: Draft request for the client. Check the wording before you send it.

name: review-sheet
title: Workpaper index and sign-off sheet
for_each: select e.id,e.code||' '||c.name as label from engagements e join clients c on c.id=e.client_id order by e.code

sections.title: File sign-off
sections.sql: select code as file,status,preparer,prepared_on,reviewer,reviewed_on,signed_by,signed_on,terms_reference,issued_on from engagements where id=$1

sections.title: Workpaper index
sections.sql: select code,title,report_line as line,prepared_by,prepared_on,evidence_reference,reviewed_by,reviewed_on from workpapers where engagement_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Review points
sections.sql: select code,workpaper,raised_by,raised_on,status,point,response,cleared_on from review_points where engagement_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Adjustments
sections.sql: select j.code,j.status,j.description,t.account_code,t.account_name,l.amount_cents from adjustments j join adjustment_lines l on l.adjustment_id=j.id join tb_lines t on t.id=l.tb_line_id where j.engagement_id=$1 order by j.code,t.account_code
